subject: Mathematics
main_theme: Counting numbers up to 9 and comparing quantities
core_concepts: Number names and numerals from 1 to 9
Identifying the biggest and smallest number
Combining groups to make a given number
activities: Match numerals with the corresponding number of objects
Identify which group has more or fewer objects
Arrange numbers from smallest to largest
Complete missing numbers in a sequence
Make groups containing a given number of objects
learning_outcomes: Count familiar objects accurately up to 9
Understand the idea of one more
Represent numbers using objects, dots and fingers
Compare two groups using more, less and equal
Find missing numbers in simple sequences
Identify the biggest and smallest number
